findings.description: Sentinel + status.json writes from today's first post-outage analyst, analyst-baby and decider runs did not persist anywhere visible. monitor/analyst/latest-analysis-summary.txt (git HEAD and FUSE) still opens "=== Analyst run 2026-08-18T00:43:52.003Z ==="; monitor/analyst-baby/latest-baby-summary.txt still reads "dome-analyst-baby run — 2026-08-18T03:31:51Z"; monitor/status.json:last_run = 2026-08-18T02:14:48.190Z and monitor/status.json:last_analyst_run = 2026-08-13T18:10:38.076Z — all byte-identical to git HEAD in three independent FUSE views (workspace-sync 10:45Z, dome-mirror 12:05Z, this session 12:21Z). The three agents each report having written them (analyst final message: "The run summary and status file are updated"; baby committed a no-op cost row; monitor/decisions/latest-decider-summary.txt:"Daily report + status.json (fresh-git-base)"). workspace-sync 10:45Z recorded 0 mtime_guard / 0 anti_reversion / 0 recent_commit_guard skips (monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-runs/run-2026-09-26T10-49-58Z.json), i.e. it saw FUSE == git for all three files — nothing to rescue. Substantive outputs from the same runs DID persist (decider rescued the analyst's FUSE-only proposals; decider committed its own summary via clone). Root cause not isolable from this session (no cross-session tool-output access): either the FUSE writes landed only in each agent's own mount view and were reverted at the 10:45Z re-population, or the postlude writes silently mis-targeted. Consequence: every FUSE-sentinel-based staleness probe (this prompt's Mode 1 check, structure-integrity.md, poller PIPELINE-HEALTH-NOTE) will read the analyst/baby/decider as ~39 days stale tomorrow even though they ran today, and monitor/status.json:last_analyst_baby_run = 2026-06-07 shows the baby field has been dead for 111 days.
findings.evidence: FUSE population mtimes on the three files are 10:45:06Z (the workspace-sync session's mount populate) while unrelated files carry 07:10Z — so the backing store DID change these files between 07:10Z and 10:45Z and the surviving content is git's. monitor/analyst/cost-history.jsonl last row run_at 2026-09-26T07:24:30Z; monitor/analyst-baby/cost-history.jsonl last row 07:44:36Z; decider commits 2535c18/1b51789 08:24Z. Distinguishing test for next run: if the 2026-09-27 04:0xZ workspace-sync rescues fresh copies of the three files, it was view staleness; if it again sees FUSE == git, it is a write-path defect and the postludes need a clone-and-push path like PROP-109 P3.

findings.description: Latent restart-day clobber path in the PROP-092 overwrite-propagation pass. monitor/scripts/sync-workspace-step4c.js:overwritePropagationPass decides git-newer-overwrite by comparing the git commit time of an allow-listed latest-*-summary.txt against last_sentinel_at (the previous dome-mirror sentinel), not against anything about the FUSE copy. After a mirror gap every allow-listed file whose git commit postdates the gap start is classified git-newer even when FUSE holds a fresher agent write. Today's cycle: monitor/integrity/sync-workspace-runs-2026-09-26T12-05-27Z.json last_sentinel_at=2026-08-18T08:34:39Z, mode=overwrite, candidates=0 — it did not fire only because FUSE already equalled git (findings[0]); had the analyst's 07:24Z summary survived to 12:05Z, the 2026-08-27 workspace-sync commit of the 08-18 summary would have qualified as newer and overwritten it. Cross-check the Phase-2 flip note in monitor/scripts/sync-workspace-step4c.config.json ("zero fuse-ahead-skip mis-fires" over the 65-day soak): true, but the soak never included a multi-week mirror gap.
findings.evidence: sync-workspace-step4c.js lines ~300-312: gitIsNewer = gitCommitMs > lastMs where lastMs = Date.parse(lastSentinelIso); FUSE hash is used only for the equality short-circuit and absent-detection.

suggested_fix.find: const gitIsNewer = isFinite(gitCommitMs) && isFinite(lastMs) && gitCommitMs > lastMs;
suggested_fix.rationale: Compare the two copies to each other, not git to a possibly-ancient sentinel. Restart days are exactly when the sentinel is oldest and the guard is weakest.
